newsitem.title: DENMARK: RESEARCH ALERT - Danske Bank ups ISS.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Danske Bank ups ISS.

text.p: Denmark's International Service System (ISS) cleaning group was raised to "match plus" from "underperform" by leading Danish bank Den Danske Bank on Wednesday.
The move came after ISS finalised last Friday the sale of its U.S. ISS Inc. unit to Canada's Aaxis Ltd.

"We consider that the sale of ISS Inc. will have a positive influence on the ISS share, not least because the remaining divisions within ISS are doing very well," analysts at Den Danske Bank said in a report.
It defined "match plus" as meaning that the share was expected to perform up to five percent better than the market in general.
The Danske Bank analysts forecast that ISS would post a pre-tax deficit of 1.691 billion crowns for the full year 1996, compared to 1995's 310 million crown pre-tax profit.
The analysts said though that there was a certain doubt attached to their estimates, notably as regards the effect of the divestment of ISS Inc. on group earnings.
The ISS share was two crowns up at 165 by mid-afternoon, having risen some 12 percent in value since last Friday's announcement of the final sale of the U.S. subsidiary.
